title: Qualify an isolated SDK 11 net11.0 C# 15 compile-and-run probe without migrating Math projects
commitMessage: test: qualify isolated .NET 11 C# 15 compiler probe

contribution.summary: Add a reproducible isolated SDK 11.0.100 compile and runtime probe under ignored build artifacts.
contribution.value: Generate a temporary zero-package net11.0/C#15 project with an exact SDK 11.0.100 pin and offline NuGet source configuration, then restore, compile and run it without changing Math sources, global.json, packages or plan states.
debtChanges: RS215 succeeded at attempt 001 first-pass true; stable SDK 11.0.100 is installed while the Math repository remains pinned to net10/C#14.
RS216 tests compiler/runtime availability using an isolated temporary project and process exit codes; no Math library compatibility, publication or adoption is implied.
M8-W02-C01 remains not-ready until the thirteen-package delta/risk audit and bounded independent consumer checks are complete.
contribution.nextAction: Inspect primary-source .NET11/C#15 deltas affecting the thirteen Math packable projects, then design targeted source-free compatibility tests without overwriting net10 packages.
